name: Repository
description: Several agent runs on one small library as a table of pull requests, issues, discussions or agents, colored by state, run, area or a label, with the runs' activity over time in the time range selector and each item's records opened in place.

records.name: event
records.one: one opening, push, review, comment, merge, close, reopen, post or sign-off

fields.name: at
fields.from: ts, time, created_at, committed_at or submitted_at
fields.how: in UTC, a time without an offset in the run's timezone

fields.name: kind
fields.from: type or event, else the export table
fields.how: push read as commit, pr.merged as merge and so on

fields.name: action
fields.how: opened, pushed, merged and so on, a review by its verdict

fields.name: verdict
fields.how: in lower case, changes_requested as changes requested

records.name: pull request
records.one: one pull request of a run, with its records

fields.name: state
fields.from: its merge, close and reopen records

fields.name: area
fields.from: labels or area, else the issue it fixes
fields.how: the first label, else the issue's area

fields.name: closes
fields.how: the first number in free text

fields.name: flags
fields.how: merged by its author, merged over a change request, pushed after its last approval, or waiting for approvals

records.name: issue
records.one: one issue of a run, with its records

fields.name: state
fields.from: its close records and the pull requests that fix it
fields.how: fixed once a pull request that fixes it merged

fields.name: elsewhere
fields.how: the same issue in each other run

fields.name: start
fields.from: the manifest's started or started_at, else the first record

accepts.means: the record on line <n> of a run's file, shown in its pull request, issue, discussion or agent opened in place, or a manifest's line, which frames its run in the time range

units.means: one run, framed in the time range
one pull request with its commits, reviews, comments and merge or close
one issue with its comments, the merge that fixed it and the same issue in the other runs
one discussion, every post in time order
one agent: every record it wrote and the note it signed off with
